import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        
        double ansx = 0, ansy = 0;
        double best = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            double[] probes = new double[2];
            probes[0] = (long) ((x * i) / y);
            probes[1] = Math.ceil((x * i) / y);
            
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                double num = probes[k];
                double diff = Math.abs(x / y - num / i);
                if (diff < best) {
                    best = diff;
                    ansx = num;
                    ansy = i;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Cast to long to remove decimal part when printing
        System.out.println((long)ansx + "/" + (long)ansy);
        sc.close();
    }
}
